source.title: CHIRPS v3 rainfall · Google Earth Engine
source.scope: Approximate town-centre grid, not district mean or field rainfall
source.limitation: Satellite/station-based rainfall estimates; daily ERA5 partitioning. Same June–September window and product for every year. Not a forecast.

source.title: ERA5-Land surface moisture and air heat · Google Earth Engine
source.scope: Modeled town-centre grid; surface soil layer 0–7 cm
source.limitation: September averages, not today’s field condition or root-zone moisture. Air heat is mean daily maximum temperature, not land surface temperature.

source.title: NOAA Oceanic Niño Index
source.scope: Pacific Niño 3.4 sea-surface temperature anomaly
source.limitation: Global climate context, not local drought probability. Selected historical examples use JJA ONI; current context uses JAS. Index baselines can be revised.

enso.limitation: El Niño is a global influence. These four historical years are selected examples, not all events or evidence of causation.
